## Summary

**Fixed:** No mechanism ever deployed claude-control's `scripts/` into `/opt/veridian/scripts/` (the path every cron job and every direct invocation actually runs) — `sync-repos.sh` only pulled inside `repos/<repo>/`. Built `scripts/deploy-live-scripts.sh` (copies only git-tracked files, so operational-only live files are structurally untouched) and wired it into a newly git-tracked `sync-repos.sh`. Deployed live: 34 files (9 stale-live-copies incl. `task-gateway.py`'s missing OWNER_ENGINE gate, 25 undeployed features), each smoke-tested. Final `diff -rq`: 0 differ, 0 repo-only.

**Delivered:** `ai-os/SCRIPTS_LIVE_VS_REPO_DRIFT_AUDIT_2026-07-25.yaml` (full classified inventory + 1 needs-owner-decision item), `ai-os/SYSTEM_INTEGRATION_CONFIRMATION_2026-07-25.yaml` (Owner's 6 points, evidence-cited), fresh wiring registry (75.95% coverage — script/file entities under-wired), MASTER_INDEX + knowledge-engine registration, PR [#67](https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/67).

**Honest bottom line:** Point 3 (software-before-AI) is now genuinely true in production. Points 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 are partially true with named, evidence-backed gaps (veda-advisors not Vercel-linked; script/file wiring coverage low; health-check-15min.py takes ~12min on a 15min schedule; the OpenRouter proxy still has two live versions; ~24 core orchestration scripts remain outside git entirely — flagged for the Owner, not fixed here since it was out of scope).
